quranTranslation.text: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „Ta Knjiga – nema sumnje u njoj.“
explanation.en: “This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt.”

quranTranslation.text: Had it not been for an ordinance of Allah which had gone before, an awful doom had come upon you on account of what ye took.

explanation.bs: Da nije odredbe od Allaha koja je prethodila – كِتَاب kao odredba.
explanation.en: If not for a decree from Allah that preceded — كِتَاب as decree.

quranTranslation.text: And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck, and We shall bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.

explanation.bs: Na Sudnjem danu izvadit ćemo mu knjigu koju će otvorenu naći – zapis djela.
explanation.en: On the Day of Resurrection We will produce for him a record which he will find spread open — the record of deeds.

quranTranslation.text: The Books of Abraham and Moses.

explanation.bs: Listovi Ibrahimovi i Musaovi.
explanation.en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

quranTranslation.text: And when the pages are laid open,

explanation.bs: Kad se listovi (djela) rastvore.
explanation.en: And when the pages are spread.

quranTranslation.text: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

explanation.bs: Poslanik od Allaha koji čita listove čiste.
explanation.en: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

explanation.bs: „Allah naređuje pravdu i dobročinstvo“ – عَدْل kao temelj.
explanation.en: “Allah enjoineth justice and kindness” — عَدْل as the foundation.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye restore deposits to their owners, and, if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly. Lo! comely is this which Allah admonisheth you. Lo! Allah is ever Hearer, Seer.

explanation.bs: Kad sudite među ljudima, sudite pravedno – pravda u sudu.
explanation.en: “If ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly” — justice in judgement.

quranTranslation.text: And guard yourselves against a day when no soul will in aught avail another, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be received from it, nor will they be helped.

explanation.bs: Na Sudnjem danu „niti će se od nje (duše) uzeti otkup“ (عَدْل) – عَدْل kao protuvrijednost.
explanation.en: On that Day “nor will compensation be received from it” (عَدْل) — عَدْل as an equivalent.

quranTranslation.text: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.

explanation.bs: „I vagajte pravedno, i ne zakidajte na vagi“ – qisṭ kao ispravna mjera.
explanation.en: “Observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof” — qisṭ as right measure.

quranTranslation.text: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.

explanation.bs: Postavit ćemo vage pravedne za Sudnji dan – qisṭ i vaga.
explanation.en: We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection — qisṭ and the scale.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Be ye staunch in justice, witnesses for Allah, even though it be against yourselves or (your) parents or (your) kindred, whether (the case be of) a rich man or a poor man, for Allah is nearer unto both (them ye are). So follow not passion lest ye lapse (from truth) and if ye lapse or fall away, then lo! Allah is ever Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Ustrajno se držite pravde, kao svjedoci Allaha radi, makar i protiv sebe samih“ – pravo svakoga da dobije svoje.
explanation.en: “Be ye staunch in justice, witnesses for Allah, even though it be against yourselves” — each given his due.

quranTranslation.text: They ask thee, (O Muhammad), of new moons, say: They are fixed seasons for mankind and for the pilgrimage. It is not righteousness that ye go to houses by the backs thereof (as do the idolaters at certain seasons), but the righteous man is he who wardeth off (evil). So go to houses by the gates thereof, and observe your duty to Allah, that ye may be successful.

explanation.bs: „Pitaju te o mlađacima“ – pitanje radi znanja.
explanation.en: “They ask thee … of new moons” — a question for knowledge.

quranTranslation.text: And when My servants question thee concerning Me, then surely I am nigh. I answer the prayer of the suppliant when he crieth unto Me. So let them hear My call and let them trust in Me, in order that they may be led aright.

explanation.bs: „A kad te robovi Moji pitaju za Mene – pa Ja sam blizu.“
explanation.en: “And when My servants question thee concerning Me, then surely I am nigh.”

quranTranslation.text: (Alms are) for the poor who are straitened for the cause of Allah, who cannot travel in the land (for trade). The unthinking man accounteth them wealthy because of their restraint. Thou shalt know them by their mark: They do not beg of men with importunity. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, lo! Allah knoweth it.

explanation.bs: Ne prose od ljudi navaljujući – سَأَلَ kao traženje imetka.
explanation.en: They do not ask people persistently — سَأَلَ as asking for property.

quranTranslation.text: They ask thee for a pronouncement. Say: Allah hath pronounced for you concerning distant kindred. If a man die childless and he have a sister, hers is half the heritage, and he would have inherited from her had she died childless. And if there be two sisters, then theirs are two-thirds of the heritage, and if they be brethren, men and women, unto the male is the equivalent of the share of two females. Allah expoundeth unto you, so that ye err not. Allah is Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „Pitaju te za fetvu. Reci: ‚O kelali vam fetvu daje Allah‘“ – pitanje o nasljedstvu.
explanation.en: “They ask thee for a pronouncement. Say: Allah hath pronounced for you concerning distant kindred” — a question of inheritance.

gloss.en: to seek a ruling, to consult

quranTranslation.text: They consult thee concerning women. Say: Allah giveth you decree concerning them, and the Scripture which hath been recited unto you (giveth decree), concerning female orphans and those unto whom ye give not that which is ordained for them though ye desire to marry them, and (concerning) the weak among children, and that ye should deal justly with orphans. Whatever good ye do, lo! Allah is ever Aware of it.

explanation.bs: „I pitaju te za fetvu o ženama. Reci: ‚Allah vam daje fetvu o njima‘“ – propis koji odgovara na pitanje.
explanation.en: “They consult thee concerning women. Say: Allah giveth you decree concerning them” — a ruling that answers the question.

gloss.en: to seek a ruling, to consult

quranTranslation.text: O my two fellow-prisoners! As for one of you, he will pour out wine for his lord to drink; and as for the other, he will be crucified so that the birds will eat from his head. Thus is the case judged concerning which ye did inquire.

explanation.bs: Jusuf zatvorenicima: „Odlučena je stvar o kojoj tražite mišljenje“ – tumačenje sna.
explanation.en: Joseph to the prisoners: “Thus is the case judged concerning which ye did inquire” — a dream's interpretation.

gloss.en: to seek a ruling, to consult

quranTranslation.text: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.

explanation.bs: „Džine i ljude stvorio sam samo zato da Mi robuju“ – džini uz ljude kao odgovorna bića.
explanation.en: “I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me” — the jinn beside humankind as accountable beings.

quranTranslation.text: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,

explanation.bs: „… skupina džina je slušala, pa su rekli: ‚Mi smo, zaista, slušali čudesan Kur'an‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj odlomak: među džinima ima muslimana i onih koji skreću.
explanation.en: “… a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an” — ar-Rāġib cites this passage: among the jinn are Muslims and those who stray.

quranTranslation.text: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.

explanation.bs: „A džanna smo prije toga stvorili od vatre koja žeže poput samuma“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: vrsta džina.
explanation.en: “And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: a kind of the jinn.

quranTranslation.text: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.

explanation.bs: „I stvorio je džanne od plamena vatre“ – stvaranje iz vatre, nasuprot čovjeku iz gline u prethodnom ajetu.
explanation.en: “And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire” — creation from fire, against man from clay in the ayah before.

quranTranslation.text: Of the jinn and of mankind.

explanation.bs: „… bilo od džina, bilo od ljudi“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za al-ǧinna kao zajednicu džina.
explanation.en: “Of the jinn and of mankind” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for al-ǧinna as the company of the jinn.

gloss.en: the company of the jinn; madness

quranTranslation.text: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).

explanation.bs: „I izmislili su srodstvo između Njega i džina, a džini dobro znaju da će i oni biti dovedeni“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him)” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: the company of the jinn; madness

quranTranslation.text: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,

explanation.bs: „onaj koji šapuće u grudi ljudi“ – šapat iznutra, bez glasa; ar-Rāġib navodi prethodni ajet (114:4) o šaptaču.
explanation.en: “Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind” — a whisper from within, without a voice; ar-Rāġib cites the ayah before (114:4) on the whisperer.

quranTranslation.text: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

explanation.bs: „Mi smo stvorili čovjeka i znamo ono što mu u sebi šapuće njegova duša“ – došaptava i sama duša, a Allah zna i to, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him” — the soul itself whispers, and Allah knows even that, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And he placed his parents on the dais and they fell down before him prostrate, and he said: O my father! This is the interpretation of my dream of old. My Lord hath made it true, and He hath shown me kindness, since He took me out of the prison and hath brought you from the desert after Satan had made strife between me and my brethren. Lo! my Lord is tender unto whom He will. He is the Knower, the Wise.

explanation.bs: Jusuf kaže da ih je Allah okupio „nakon što je šejtan posijao razdor između mene i moje braće“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Joseph says Allah brought them together “after Satan had made strife between me and my brethren” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to stir up strife, to sow discord

quranTranslation.text: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.

explanation.bs: „Kaži Mojim robovima da izgovaraju ono što je najbolje; šejtan zaista među njima podbada …“ – lijepa riječ kao zaštita od razdora.
explanation.en: “Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them” — the kindly word as a guard against strife.

gloss.en: to stir up strife, to sow discord

quranTranslation.text: And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.

explanation.bs: Jakub sinovima: „Ne, nego su vam vaše duše nešto uljepšale – zato: strpljenje dostojno …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Jacob to his sons: “Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to make seem fair, to entice

quranTranslation.text: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me.

explanation.bs: Samirija se pravda: „… i tako mi je to moja duša prikazala lijepim“ – sam priznaje da je ružno vidio kao dobro.
explanation.en: The Samiri excuses himself: “Thus my soul commended to me” — he admits he saw the ugly as good.

gloss.en: to make seem fair, to entice
